description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, used for encapsulating filter parameters such as date range and employee number for searching timesheets.
external_methods: FilterParams (constructor or methods assumed to be inherited but not explicitly called or overridden here)

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams with properties for date range and employee number used for timesheet searches.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the timesheet search filter.
